messages:
maria-billing: Hi team — customer AcmeAnalytics tried to pay invoice INV-2024-348 with a Visa (last4 4242) and got a decline. Gateway returned an AVS/CVV/address mismatch + cardholder verification required. Gateway response:
```json
{"status":"declined","reason":"avs_cv_verification_failed","code":"cardholder_verification_required","gateway_code":"do_not_honor"}
```
Customer insists address matches. Need quick advice: escalate to gateway or offer manual payment? @nate-payments @anjali-support :thinking_face:

anjali-support: thanks Maria. Can you paste the minimal request payload and the payment attempt timestamp? Also ask customer to confirm billing address formatting (AVS is picky about abbreviations and punctuation).

maria-billing: payload:
```http
POST /v1/payments
{ "invoice_id": "INV-2024-348", "card_last4": "4242", "billing_address": { "line1": "123 Market St", "city": "SF", "state": "CA", "zip": "94103" }}
```
Attempt TS (gateway): 1727001002. Customer actually originally submitted zip as 94103-1234.

sam-eng: tagging in — any recent changes to gateway rule config? I'll pull the logs. @gateway-bot can you show the triggered rule id?

gateway-bot: rule_id: AVS_STRICT_v2 triggered. extra_info: issuer_requires_cardholder_verification.

nate-payments: If issuer flagged verification required, that usually means the issuing bank declined on verification grounds. We should not override. Ask customer to retry with full ZIP + apt if applicable, or use another card. We can offer ACH/manual payment as an alternative.

frank-cs: Customer is on the line and wants to pay now. Any temporary path?

nate-payments: I can set up a manual bank transfer option and mark invoice pending-paid once finance confirms receipt. Also will open a ticket with the gateway to review AVS_STRICT_v2 for small amounts.

anjali-support: I'll request customer confirm exact billing address as it appears on their card statement and to retry. If they can, ask for a screenshot of their billing address (redact PAN).

maria-billing: Customer updated address to: "123 Market St., Apt 2, San Francisco, CA 94103" and retried — payment succeeded. Gateway returned:
```json
{"status":"succeeded","gateway_code":"approved"}
```
Marking resolved on our side. Action items: remind CS to ask for full ZIP (4-digit suffix) and apt number, and offer ACH if immediate payment is required.

nate-payments: Thanks. Can we add a short UI hint in the billing modal: "Use billing ZIP as shown on your card statement (include 4-digit suffix)"? cc @sam-eng for a quick copy patch.

sam-eng: small copy change, will roll out to billing modal today. Created ticket BLG-712.

maria-billing: closing thread — invoice paid, customer happy. Adding KB note on AVS/CVV troubleshooting and escalate path to payments team. :white_check_mark:
